items.author: Block Scholes
items.title: ETH leads a rise in implied volatility
items.view: Block Scholes reports 30-day implied volatility at 43.3% for BTC, 60.2% for ETH and 63.0% for SOL. All rose over seven days; ETH gained the most, at 5.3 points.

archivedNew.author: QCP Capital
archivedNew.title: Short-tenor volatility rises ahead of the Fed
archivedNew.view: QCP reported short-tenor implied volatility rising from about 30% to 35%. It observed demand for downside protection through November. This was a pre-Fed view.
